chapter: Touring in the bus years and Jim Crow in the South
title: Leslie Sheffield, the Pittsfield booking and Rudy Morrison
summary: Sheffield, formerly of Trent's band, helped set up Fields' Pittsfield tour; Rudy Morrison later went to Billy Eckstine.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did Leslie Sheffield ever play with you?
Sure. I got a picture I want to show you. Leslie, now the first big deal that I went on in New York, I'll tell you about Leslie. Leslie really (inaudible) me on my first trip to New York.

those area bookers. Like I'm a booking agent, maybe somebody would contact me and say I would like you to work the tri-state area, or something like that. Well, Leslie had been to New York State with Trent and came back--now, he was one of those youngsters that I admired so. When I came back I hit on Leslie again--I'll show you the pictures I have--Leslie was in my first big band. And so, Leslie said yes and so when we got to going pretty good he said, did you want to go back east? I said yeah. He said well, there's a good chance, I think I can contact a fellow in Pittsfield, Mass. that apparently had Trent up there and said, Trent was all right, but they weren't really tight together. He said we can take it, let's go there, I'll contact him if you say you'll go. I said write him, or give me an address and so he gave me the address and I contacted this guy in Pittsfield and he carried us to Pittsfield, Mass. Leslie was responsible for it and set it up.

with the first band I went to New York with. MR. FIELDS: Sure enough. MR. LOVE: Snub Mosley, 1943; earlier in the year. I joined Basie later that year. Leslie just died a year or two ago in Oklahoma City. MR. FIELDS: Yes, he sure did. I was fortunate enough--I don't call the funeral fortunate--but I was glad I was around to go. MR. LOVE: What did he die from? MR. FIELDS: Cancer. MR. LOVE: Did you know Rudy Morrison? MR. FIELDS: Yeah, sure, Rudy played with me also. MR. LOVE: I know. We worked together too. MR. FIELDS: Rudy left me and I think he went with Billy Eckstine when Billy had his band. MR. LOVE: Rudy died several years ago.
Yeah a number of years, but it hasn't been too long for Leslie. He was a very fine guy and everything, and Les was a fine arranger too.
